description:
A CLI to align versions and coordinates in Apache Ant projects, modelled on the Maven
    POM Manipulation Extension (PME) and the Gradle Manipulator (GME). It supports rebuilding
    pre-existing projects in a cleanroom environment: discover published coordinates, align them
    against a Dependency Analyzer service, and rewrite the build files in place. This is the parent
    aggregator; the modules (common, core, cli, integration-test) mirror PME's layout.
